items.headline: Kaziranga grassland bird census records 43 species
items.detail: A grassland bird census in Kaziranga National Park, Assam recorded 43 species. Nests of the Finn's Weaver were also found.

items.headline: V.O. Chidambaranar Port begins green hydrogen production
items.detail: V.O. Chidambaranar Port in Tamil Nadu became the first port in India to produce green hydrogen.
examFacts: First port to produce green hydrogen: V.O. Chidambaranar Port

items.headline: Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan to train 20 lakh tribal change leaders
items.detail: The Ministry of Tribal Affairs launched the Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan, called the world's largest tribal grassroots leadership programme. It aims to build 20 lakh tribal change leaders across 1 lakh tribal villages in 550 districts of 30 States and UTs.

items.headline: Magnus Carlsen wins first chess Esports World Cup
items.detail: Magnus Carlsen won the first chess event of the Esports World Cup, held in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

items.headline: Matri Van urban forest planned in the Aravallis
items.detail: A 750-acre urban forest named 'Matri Van' is being developed in the Aravalli hills in Gurugram, Haryana.

items.headline: NITI Aayog report on electric mobility
items.detail: A NITI Aayog report on electric vehicles set out the goal of 30% EV sales by 2030. Its Electric Mobility Index placed Delhi, Maharashtra and Chandigarh among the front-runners.

items.headline: India is the world's 5th largest aviation market: IATA
items.detail: According to IATA, India is the fifth largest aviation market in the world with 211 million passengers.

items.headline: Moldova becomes 107th member of International Solar Alliance
items.detail: Moldova joined the International Solar Alliance (ISA) as its 107th member country.

items.headline: Punjab first state to empanel sign language interpreters
items.detail: Punjab became the first state to empanel sign language interpreters to help people with hearing and speech disabilities.
examFacts: First state to empanel sign language interpreters: Punjab

items.headline: Philippines President Marcos makes state visit to India
items.detail: Philippines President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. visited India from August 4-8, 2025. The two countries raised ties to a Strategic Partnership and signed 14 MoUs. India and the Philippines also held their first bilateral maritime cooperative activity in the South China Sea.

items.headline: ISRO's HOPE analog mission held in Ladakh
items.detail: ISRO carried out the HOPE analog space mission at Tso Kar in Ladakh from August 1-10, 2025.
examFacts: HOPE analog mission: Tso Kar, Ladakh

items.headline: New rain snake species found in Mizoram
items.detail: Researchers from Mizoram University found a new rain snake species, Smithophis leptofasciatus (narrow-banded rain snake), in Mizoram. The genus Smithophis now has five known species.

items.headline: India nominates Sarnath for UNESCO World Heritage List
items.detail: India nominated Sarnath near Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, for the UNESCO World Heritage List in the 2025-26 cycle. It is one of the four most sacred Buddhist sites.

items.headline: AU Small Finance Bank gets nod to become universal bank
items.detail: RBI gave in-principle approval to AU Small Finance Bank to convert into a universal bank. It is the first such approval in 11 years.
examFacts: AU SFB: in-principle nod for universal bank

items.headline: Satnavri becomes India's first smart intelligent village
items.detail: Satnavri in Nagpur district, Maharashtra became India's first 'smart intelligent village', with drone farming, smart irrigation and digital services for its 1,800 residents.
examFacts: First smart intelligent village: Satnavri, Nagpur, Maharashtra

items.headline: Skyroot tests Kalam-1200 solid rocket motor
items.detail: Skyroot Aerospace carried out a static fire test of its Kalam-1200 solid rocket motor at Sriharikota. The motor is 11 metres long and carries 30 tonnes of propellant.

items.headline: Rishabh Yadav wins India's first individual archery medal at World Games
items.detail: Rishabh Yadav won bronze in men's individual compound archery at the World Games 2025 in Chengdu, China. It is India's first individual archery medal at the World Games.

items.headline: Defence production hits record Rs 1.51 lakh crore in FY25
items.detail: India's defence production reached a record Rs 1.51 lakh crore in FY25, 18% higher than the previous year. Defence exports rose to Rs 23,622 crore.
examFacts: FY25 defence production: Rs 1.51 lakh crore

items.headline: India qualify for AFC U-20 Women's Asian Cup after 20 years
items.detail: India's U-20 women's football team qualified for the AFC U-20 Women's Asian Cup 2026 for the first time in 20 years, after beating Myanmar 1-0 in Yangon. Thailand will host the 2026 event.
examFacts: Qualified: AFC U-20 Women's Asian Cup 2026

items.headline: Retail inflation falls to 1.55% in July
items.detail: CPI retail inflation fell to 1.55% in July 2025, the lowest in about eight years. Food inflation stood at 1.76%.

items.headline: India's solar module manufacturing capacity crosses 100 GW
items.detail: India's solar PV module manufacturing capacity crossed 100 GW, up from 2.3 GW in 2014, according to the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.

items.headline: S. Rohith Krishna becomes India's 89th Grandmaster
items.detail: S. Rohith Krishna, 19, from Tamil Nadu, became India's 89th chess Grandmaster.
examFacts: India's 89th GM: S. Rohith Krishna (Tamil Nadu)

items.headline: India's first hydrogen train completes load trials
items.detail: India's first hydrogen-powered train completed load tests in Chennai. It will run on the 89 km Jind-Sonipat route in Haryana.

items.headline: PLFS: unemployment rate 5.4% in April-June quarter
items.detail: The Periodic Labour Force Survey showed an unemployment rate of 5.4% in the April-June 2025 quarter and 5.2% in July 2025.

items.headline: Dwarka Expressway and UER-II opened in Delhi
items.detail: The Delhi section of the Dwarka Expressway and the Urban Extension Road-II (UER-II), projects worth about Rs 11,000 crore, were inaugurated.
examFacts: Projects: Dwarka Expressway (Delhi section) and UER-II

items.headline: WHO declares Nepal free of rubella
items.detail: WHO declared Nepal free of rubella. Nepal is the sixth country in the WHO South-East Asia Region to reach this goal.

items.headline: India and EAEU sign terms for free trade talks
items.detail: India and the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) signed the Terms of Reference in Moscow to start FTA negotiations. Their trade reached USD 69 billion in 2024.

items.headline: Jaishankar co-chairs 26th India-Russia IRIGC-TEC
items.detail: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar visited Moscow from August 19-21, 2025 for the 26th session of the India-Russia Inter-Governmental Commission (IRIGC-TEC). The two sides aim for USD 100 billion trade by 2030.

items.headline: GoM backs two-slab GST structure
items.detail: The Group of Ministers chaired by Bihar Deputy CM Samrat Choudhary accepted the proposal to replace the four GST slabs with two: 5% for merit goods and 18% for standard items.

items.headline: India wins 4 golds at astronomy olympiad in Mumbai
items.detail: The 18th International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics was held in Mumbai from August 11-21, 2025 with over 300 students from 64 countries. India won 4 gold medals and 1 silver.

items.headline: Income-Tax Act, 2025 gets President's assent
items.detail: President Droupadi Murmu gave assent to the Income-Tax Act, 2025, which will come into force on April 1, 2026. It cuts sections from 819 to 536 and chapters from 47 to 23.

items.headline: Rajit Punhani appointed FSSAI CEO
items.detail: Rajit Punhani, a 1991-batch IAS officer, was appointed CEO of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, succeeding G. Kamala V. Rao.

items.headline: India elected to chair AIBD
items.detail: India was elected chair of the Asia-Pacific Institute for Broadcasting Development (AIBD) at its 23rd General Conference in Phuket, Thailand, held August 19-21, 2025.

items.headline: Online Gaming Act 2025 bans online money games
items.detail: President Droupadi Murmu gave assent to the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Bill, 2025, introduced in the Lok Sabha by Ashwini Vaishnaw on August 20. Offering online money games can bring up to 3 years in jail and a fine of Rs 1 crore.
examFacts: Penalty: up to 3 years and Rs 1 crore fine

items.headline: Nepal joins International Big Cat Alliance as 13th member
items.detail: Nepal became the 13th member of the India-led International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA). The alliance works to protect seven big cat species and is headquartered in New Delhi.

items.headline: DRDO conducts first flight tests of IADWS
items.detail: DRDO carried out the first flight tests of the Integrated Air Defence Weapon System (IADWS) off the Odisha coast. The system combines QRSAM, VSHORADS and a laser-based directed energy weapon.

items.headline: NorthEast United win 134th Durand Cup
items.detail: NorthEast United FC beat Diamond Harbour FC 6-1 in the final of the 134th Durand Cup in Kolkata. Alaaeddine Ajaraie won both the Golden Player and Golden Boot awards.

items.headline: India to supply fortified rice to World Food Programme
items.detail: India and the World Food Programme signed an agreement for India to supply up to 200,000 metric tonnes of fortified rice over five years.
examFacts: Fortified rice: up to 2 lakh tonnes over 5 years

items.headline: PM SVANidhi extended till March 2030
items.detail: The PM SVANidhi scheme for street vendors was extended till March 31, 2030 with an outlay of Rs 7,332 crore. Loan limits were raised to Rs 15,000, Rs 25,000 and Rs 50,000 for the three tranches.

items.headline: INS Udaygiri and INS Himgiri commissioned together
items.detail: The Navy commissioned the frigates INS Udaygiri (built by MDL) and INS Himgiri (built by GRSE) at Visakhapatnam. They are the 100th and 101st warships designed in-house by the Navy.
examFacts: INS Udaygiri: MDL; INS Himgiri: GRSE

items.headline: Goa to host FIDE World Cup 2025
items.detail: Goa was chosen to host the FIDE World Cup from October 30 to November 27, 2025, with 206 players and a prize fund of USD 2 million.

items.headline: Urjit Patel named IMF Executive Director
items.detail: Former RBI Governor Urjit Patel was appointed Executive Director at the International Monetary Fund for three years.

items.headline: UDISE+ 2024-25: teachers cross 1 crore
items.detail: The UDISE+ 2024-25 report showed that the number of school teachers crossed 1 crore for the first time. School enrolment fell by 11 lakh to 24.69 crore.

items.headline: Rajeev Shukla becomes interim BCCI President
items.detail: Rajeev Shukla became interim President of the BCCI after Roger Binny stepped down on turning 70.

items.headline: Sundarbans becomes India's second largest tiger reserve
items.detail: The NBWL Standing Committee approved adding the Matla, Raidighi and Ramganga ranges to the Sundarbans Tiger Reserve. Its area rises to about 3,629.57 sq km, second only to Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve.

items.headline: AQLI 2025: air pollution cuts Indian life expectancy by 3.5 years
items.detail: The Air Quality Life Index 2025 said air pollution reduces the average life expectancy of Indians by 3.5 years.
examFacts: Life expectancy lost to air pollution: 3.5 years

items.headline: EY sees India as second largest economy by PPP by 2038
items.detail: An EY report projected that India will become the world's second largest economy by purchasing power parity by 2038, with a GDP of USD 34.2 trillion.

items.headline: Banking Laws (Amendment) Act provisions come into force
items.detail: Key provisions of the Banking Laws (Amendment) Act, 2025 came into force on August 1, 2025. The limit for 'substantial interest' in a bank was raised from Rs 5 lakh to Rs 2 crore, and the tenure of directors in cooperative banks was extended to 10 years.
examFacts: 'Substantial interest' limit: Rs 5 lakh raised to Rs 2 crore
Cooperative bank directors: tenure up to 10 years

items.headline: Lt Gen Pushpendra Singh becomes Vice Chief of Army Staff
items.detail: Lieutenant General Pushpendra Singh took over as the Vice Chief of the Army Staff on August 1, 2025.
examFacts: New VCOAS: Lt Gen Pushpendra Singh (from August 1, 2025)

items.headline: Vice Admiral Sanjay Vatsayan is 47th Vice Chief of Naval Staff
items.detail: Vice Admiral Sanjay Vatsayan took charge as the 47th Vice Chief of the Naval Staff on August 1, 2025.
examFacts: 47th Vice Chief of Naval Staff: Vice Adm Sanjay Vatsayan

items.headline: 71st National Film Awards: '12th Fail' is Best Feature Film
items.detail: The 71st National Film Awards were announced on August 1, 2025. '12th Fail' won Best Feature Film, and the Best Actor award was shared by Vikrant Massey and Shah Rukh Khan.
examFacts: Best Actor (shared): Vikrant Massey and Shah Rukh Khan

items.headline: A. Rajarajan takes charge as VSSC Director
items.detail: A. Rajarajan became Director of ISRO's Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC) on August 1, 2025.

items.headline: New UPI rules cap balance checks at 50 a day
items.detail: New UPI usage rules came into effect on August 1, 2025. Users can check their account balance up to 50 times a day on each UPI app.
examFacts: UPI balance enquiry: 50 per app per day (from August 1, 2025)

items.headline: 20th PM-KISAN instalment released from Varanasi
items.detail: PM Modi released the 20th instalment of PM-KISAN from Varanasi on August 2, 2025. About Rs 20,500 crore was sent to around 9.7 crore farmers.

items.headline: Lando Norris wins Hungarian GP, McLaren's 200th win
items.detail: Lando Norris won the Hungarian Grand Prix on August 3, 2025. It was McLaren's 200th Formula 1 victory.

items.headline: Former Jharkhand CM Shibu Soren dies at 81
items.detail: Shibu Soren, the Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM) leader who served three times as Chief Minister of Jharkhand, died on August 4, 2025 at the age of 81.

items.headline: India-England Anderson-Tendulkar Trophy drawn 2-2
items.detail: The five-Test Anderson-Tendulkar Trophy between India and England ended 2-2 on August 4, 2025. Shubman Gill scored 754 runs, and Gill and Harry Brook were named joint Players of the Series.
examFacts: Joint Players of the Series: Gill and Brook

items.headline: Former Governor Satyapal Malik dies at 79
items.detail: Former Governor Satyapal Malik died on August 5, 2025 at the age of 79.

items.headline: DAC clears proposals worth Rs 67,000 crore
items.detail: The Defence Acquisition Council cleared capital acquisition proposals worth about Rs 67,000 crore on August 5, 2025.

items.headline: Gujarat is India's top exporting state
items.detail: An FIEO analysis of DGCIS data showed Gujarat as the top exporting state with exports of Rs 9.83 lakh crore, or 26.6% of the total. Maharashtra was second with Rs 5.57 lakh crore.

items.headline: Jensen Huang tops Fortune's most powerful business leaders
items.detail: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang topped Fortune's list of the 100 Most Powerful People in Business. Mukesh Ambani was ranked 56th.

items.headline: PM inaugurates Kartavya Bhavan-3
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated Kartavya Bhavan-3 in New Delhi.

items.headline: 80th anniversary of Hiroshima and Nagasaki bombings
items.detail: Hiroshima Day on August 6 and Nagasaki Day on August 9, 2025 marked 80 years since the USA dropped atomic bombs on the two Japanese cities in 1945.

items.headline: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.50%
items.detail: The RBI Monetary Policy Committee met from August 4-6, 2025 and unanimously kept the repo rate at 5.50% with a neutral stance. The SDF rate stayed at 5.25% and the MSF rate at 5.75%.

items.headline: MoSPI proposes new base years for GDP, IIP and CPI
items.detail: MoSPI proposed to revise the base year of GDP and IIP to 2022-23 and the base year of CPI to 2024, to better capture changes in the economy.

items.headline: Army inducts minefield marking equipment MMME Mk-II
items.detail: The Indian Army inducted the Mechanical Minefield Marking Equipment Mk-II on August 6, 2025. It was developed by DRDO's R&DE(E) and built by BEML on a TATRA 6x6 vehicle.
examFacts: MMME Mk-II: developed by DRDO's R&DE(E)

items.headline: 11th National Handloom Day observed
items.detail: The 11th National Handloom Day was observed on August 7, 2025. The day was first observed in 2015, when PM Modi launched it in Chennai.

items.headline: Myanmar's former acting President Myint Swe dies
items.detail: Myint Swe, who was Myanmar's acting President from 2021 to 2024 after the military coup, died in Naypyitaw on August 7, 2025 at the age of 74.
examFacts: Myint Swe: acting President of Myanmar, 2021-2024

items.headline: M.S. Swaminathan centenary conference and first global award
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated the M.S. Swaminathan Centenary Conference at Pusa, New Delhi (August 7-9, 2025) on the theme 'Evergreen Revolution - Path to Bio-Happiness'. He released a Rs 100 coin, and Nigerian scientist Prof. Ademola A. Adenle received the first Global M.S. Swaminathan Award.
examFacts: First Global M.S. Swaminathan Award: Prof. Ademola A. Adenle (Nigeria)

items.headline: Cabinet approves MERITE scheme for technical education
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved the MERITE scheme with an outlay of Rs 4,200 crore, including a Rs 2,100 crore World Bank loan. It will cover 275 technical institutions from 2025-26 to 2029-30.

items.headline: Rs 300 LPG subsidy continued under Ujjwala Yojana
items.detail: The Cabinet approved Rs 12,000 crore to continue the Rs 300 subsidy per 14.2 kg cylinder for PM Ujjwala Yojana users, for up to 9 refills a year. It also approved Rs 30,000 crore to IOCL, BPCL and HPCL for losses on domestic LPG.
examFacts: PMUY subsidy: Rs 300 per cylinder, up to 9 refills a year

items.headline: Special development packages for Assam and Tripura
items.detail: The Cabinet approved special development packages for Assam and Tripura with a central outlay of Rs 4,250 crore, including Rs 3,000 crore for ULFA-affected areas.
examFacts: Includes Rs 3,000 crore for ULFA-affected areas

items.headline: GeM marks 9th Foundation Day
items.detail: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) celebrated its 9th Foundation Day on August 9, 2025 on the theme 'Ease, Access and Inclusion'. Its gross merchandise value in FY25 was Rs 5.4 lakh crore.
examFacts: GeM FY25 GMV: Rs 5.4 lakh crore

items.headline: International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples
items.detail: The day was observed on August 9, 2025 with the theme 'Indigenous Peoples and Artificial Intelligence: Defending Rights, Shaping Futures'.

items.headline: India's first animal stem cell biobank opens in Hyderabad
items.detail: Union Minister Jitendra Singh inaugurated India's first Animal Stem Cell Biobank at the National Institute of Animal Biotechnology (NIAB), Hyderabad on August 9, 2025.
examFacts: First Animal Stem Cell Biobank: NIAB, Hyderabad

items.headline: Three Vande Bharat trains and Bengaluru Metro Yellow Line launched
items.detail: On August 10, 2025, Vande Bharat trains were launched on the Ajni (Nagpur)-Pune, Bengaluru-Belagavi and Katra-Amritsar routes. The Bengaluru Metro Yellow Line was opened and the foundation of Metro Phase-3 was laid.
examFacts: New Vande Bharat routes: Ajni-Pune, Bengaluru-Belagavi, Katra-Amritsar

items.headline: Asiatic lion count rises to 891
items.detail: On World Lion Day (August 10), it was noted that the Asiatic lion population rose from 674 in 2020 to 891 in 2025, a 32.2% increase in five years.

items.headline: Cabinet approves four new semiconductor units
items.detail: The Cabinet approved four new semiconductor units in Punjab, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh with an investment of Rs 4,600 crore. This takes the total under the India Semiconductor Mission to 10 projects worth about Rs 1.60 lakh crore.

items.headline: World Elephant Day and International Youth Day
items.detail: World Elephant Day was observed on August 12, 2025, with the national event held in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. International Youth Day, also on August 12, had the theme 'Local Youth Actions for the SDGs and Beyond'.

items.headline: Cabinet clears Lucknow Metro Phase-1B and Tato-II hydro project
items.detail: The Cabinet approved Lucknow Metro Phase-1B (11.165 km, 12 stations, Rs 5,801 crore) and the 700 MW Tato-II hydroelectric project in Shi Yomi district, Arunachal Pradesh (Rs 8,146.21 crore).

items.headline: RBI moves cheque clearing to continuous mode
items.detail: RBI announced that cheques under the Cheque Truncation System will be cleared continuously on the same day instead of in a two-day cycle. Phase I starts on October 4, 2025 and Phase II on January 3, 2026.
examFacts: CTS continuous clearing Phase I: October 4, 2025

items.headline: Partition Horrors Remembrance Day
items.detail: The fifth Partition Horrors Remembrance Day was observed on August 14, 2025 to remember the people affected by the 1947 Partition. The day was declared in 2021.

items.headline: Jal Jeevan Mission completes six years
items.detail: Under the Jal Jeevan Mission, more than 15.69 crore rural households, or 81% of rural India, have been connected to tap water.

items.headline: SLINEX-2025 held in Colombo
items.detail: The 12th edition of the India-Sri Lanka naval exercise SLINEX was held in Colombo from August 14-18, 2025.

items.headline: Navy receives third survey vessel Ikshak
items.detail: GRSE delivered Ikshak, the third Survey Vessel (Large), to the Indian Navy. It is the first ship of its class with accommodation for women officers and sailors.

items.headline: PM's 12th Independence Day speech announces new missions
items.detail: On the 79th Independence Day, PM Modi gave his 12th straight speech from the Red Fort, lasting 103 minutes. He announced the PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana, Mission Sudarshan Chakra to be completed by 2035, and a High-Powered Demography Mission.
examFacts: 79th Independence Day: 12th consecutive speech by PM Modi

items.headline: Nagaland Governor La. Ganesan dies at 80
items.detail: La. Ganesan, the Governor of Nagaland, died in Chennai on August 15, 2025 at the age of 80. Ajay Kumar Bhalla, a 1984-batch IAS officer, was given additional charge as Governor of Nagaland.

items.headline: PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana portal launched
items.detail: The PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana has a budget of Rs 99,446 crore and aims to create 3.5 crore jobs from August 2025 to July 2027. A portal for employer registration was launched.

items.headline: World Humanitarian Day observed
items.detail: World Humanitarian Day was observed on August 19, 2025. It marks the 2003 bombing of the UN office in Baghdad and was first observed in 2009.

items.headline: CCS approves 97 more Tejas Mk1A jets
items.detail: The Cabinet Committee on Security approved the purchase of 97 Light Combat Aircraft Tejas Mk1A for the Indian Air Force from HAL at about Rs 62,000 crore. The jets will have 65% indigenous content.

items.headline: Cabinet clears Odisha ring road and Kota-Bundi airport
items.detail: The Cabinet approved a 110.875 km six-lane Capital Region Ring Road in Odisha (Rs 8,307.74 crore) and a greenfield airport at Kota-Bundi, Rajasthan (Rs 1,507 crore).
examFacts: Odisha Capital Region Ring Road: 110.875 km

items.headline: Agni-5 successfully test-fired
items.detail: India successfully test-fired the Agni-5 intermediate-range ballistic missile from the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur, Odisha on August 20, 2025. It has a range of over 5,000 km.

items.headline: World Mosquito Day and Sadbhavana Diwas
items.detail: World Mosquito Day on August 20 marks Sir Ronald Ross's 1897 discovery that female Anopheles mosquitoes spread malaria. Sadbhavana Diwas was also observed on the birth anniversary of Rajiv Gandhi.

items.headline: Khelo India Water Sports Festival held at Dal Lake
items.detail: The Khelo India Water Sports Festival was held at Dal Lake, Srinagar from August 21-23, 2025. Madhya Pradesh topped the table with 10 golds. The mascot was a Himalayan Kingfisher.

items.headline: Industrialist Lord Swraj Paul dies at 94
items.detail: UK-based industrialist Lord Swraj Paul, founder of the Caparo Group and a member of the House of Lords, died on August 21, 2025 at the age of 94. He received the Padma Bhushan in 1983.
examFacts: Swraj Paul: founder of Caparo Group

items.headline: Indranil Bhattacharyya joins RBI Monetary Policy Committee
items.detail: RBI Executive Director Indranil Bhattacharyya was named an ex-officio member of the Monetary Policy Committee, replacing Rajiv Ranjan.

items.headline: Former CPI General Secretary Suravaram Sudhakar Reddy dies
items.detail: Suravaram Sudhakar Reddy, who became General Secretary of the Communist Party of India in 2012 and was twice MP from Nalgonda, died on August 22, 2025 at the age of 83.

items.headline: National Space Day celebrated
items.detail: National Space Day on August 23 marks the Chandrayaan-3 landing of 2023. The 2025 theme was 'Aryabhatta to Gaganyaan: Ancient Wisdom to Infinite Possibilities'.

items.headline: All India Speakers' Conference marks Vitthalbhai Patel centenary
items.detail: Amit Shah inaugurated the All India Speakers' Conference at the Delhi Assembly on August 24, 2025. It marked 100 years since Vitthalbhai Patel became the first elected Indian Speaker.
examFacts: First elected Indian Speaker: Vitthalbhai Patel (1925)

items.headline: Anish Dayal Singh appointed Deputy NSA
items.detail: Former CRPF and ITBP chief Anish Dayal Singh, a 1988-batch IPS officer, was appointed Deputy National Security Advisor.

items.headline: Fiji PM Rabuka visits India
items.detail: Fiji Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka visited India from August 24-26, 2025, and the two sides signed 9 MoUs.

items.headline: National Biofoundry Network launched
items.detail: Union Minister Jitendra Singh launched India's first National Biofoundry Network of six institutions, along with the BioE3 Challenge for young people.

items.headline: PM Jan Dhan Yojana completes 11 years
items.detail: PM Jan Dhan Yojana completed 11 years on August 28, 2025, with 56.16 crore accounts holding deposits of Rs 2,67,756 crore.

items.headline: NARI 2025 names Kohima safest city for women
items.detail: The NARI 2025 report gave India a women's safety score of 65%. Kohima, Visakhapatnam and Bhubaneswar were among the safest cities.

items.headline: India joins Exercise Bright Star in Egypt
items.detail: India sent more than 700 personnel to the 19th edition of the multinational Exercise Bright Star in Egypt, held from August 28 to September 10, 2025.

items.headline: National Sports Day celebrated
items.detail: National Sports Day was observed from August 29-31, 2025 with the theme 'Ek Ghanta, Khel ke Maidan Main'.

items.headline: State Energy Efficiency Index 2024 released
items.detail: The State Energy Efficiency Index 2024 assessed 36 States and UTs. Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Assam and Tripura were top performers.
examFacts: Top performers include Maharashtra and Andhra Pradesh

items.headline: Supreme Court reaches full strength of 34 judges
items.detail: Justices Alok Aradhe and Vipul Manubhai Pancholi took oath as Supreme Court judges on August 29, 2025, taking the court to its full sanctioned strength of 34.

items.headline: PM Modi attends 15th India-Japan Annual Summit
items.detail: PM Modi visited Japan on August 29-30, 2025 for the 15th India-Japan Annual Summit. Japan pledged investment of JPY 10 trillion (about USD 65 billion) over 10 years.
examFacts: Japan investment pledge: JPY 10 trillion over 10 years

items.headline: National Small Industry Day observed
items.detail: National Small Industry Day is observed on August 30 to mark the small-scale industries policy announced on August 30, 2000 by PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

items.headline: India top Asian Shooting Championship with 99 medals
items.detail: India won 99 medals, including 50 gold, 26 silver and 23 bronze, at the Asian Shooting Championship held in Shymkent, Kazakhstan from August 16-30, 2025.

items.headline: India win 40 medals at Commonwealth Weightlifting Championships
items.detail: India won 40 medals (27 gold, 10 silver, 3 bronze) at the 30th Commonwealth Weightlifting Championships in Ahmedabad from August 24-30, 2025. Mirabai Chanu won gold in the women's 48 kg category.

items.headline: Educate Girls is first Indian organisation to win Magsaysay Award
items.detail: Educate Girls, founded by Safeena Husain in 2007, was announced on August 31, 2025 as a winner of the Ramon Magsaysay Award. It is the first Indian organisation to win the award.
examFacts: Educate Girls: founded 2007 by Safeena Husain
First Indian organisation to win the Magsaysay Award

items.headline: Oscar Piastri wins Dutch Grand Prix
items.detail: Oscar Piastri of McLaren won the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort on August 31, 2025, with Max Verstappen second.

quiz.q: Which film won Best Feature Film at the 71st National Film Awards announced in August 2025?
quiz.solution: '12th Fail' won Best Feature Film; the Best Actor award was shared by Vikrant Massey and Shah Rukh Khan.

quiz.q: At what level did the RBI keep the repo rate in its August 2025 policy?
quiz.solution: The MPC unanimously kept the repo rate at 5.50% with a neutral stance.

quiz.q: How many Tejas Mk1A jets did the CCS approve in August 2025?
quiz.solution: The CCS approved 97 Tejas Mk1A jets from HAL for about Rs 62,000 crore.

quiz.q: After its August 2025 expansion, the Sundarbans Tiger Reserve is second in size only to which reserve?
quiz.solution: Sundarbans grew to about 3,629.57 sq km, behind Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve.

quiz.q: From which date will the Income-Tax Act, 2025 come into force?
quiz.solution: The Act received assent in August 2025 and takes effect on April 1, 2026.

quiz.q: Who founded Educate Girls, the first Indian organisation to win the Ramon Magsaysay Award?
quiz.solution: Safeena Husain founded Educate Girls in 2007.

quiz.q: Where was the Asian Shooting Championship 2025, in which India won 99 medals, held?
quiz.solution: India won 99 medals, including 50 gold, in Shymkent, Kazakhstan.

quiz.q: Nepal became which member of the International Big Cat Alliance in August 2025?
quiz.solution: Nepal became the 13th member of the India-led IBCA.

quiz.q: What was the Asiatic lion population reported in 2025?
quiz.solution: The count rose from 674 in 2020 to 891 in 2025.

quiz.q: How much investment did Japan pledge to India at the 15th Annual Summit in August 2025?
quiz.solution: Japan pledged JPY 10 trillion (about USD 65 billion) over 10 years.

items.headline: PM attends 25th SCO Summit in Tianjin
items.detail: PM Modi visited China from August 31 to September 1, 2025 for the 25th SCO Summit in Tianjin, his first official visit to China since 2018. Laos was given SCO dialogue partner status.

items.headline: Manufacturing PMI hits 17-year high of 59.3
items.detail: India's Manufacturing PMI rose to 59.3 in August 2025, its highest level since 2008.

items.headline: UPI crosses 20 billion monthly transactions
items.detail: UPI crossed 20 billion transactions in a single month for the first time in August 2025, with 20.01 billion transactions worth Rs 24.85 lakh crore.

items.headline: CAA cut-off date extended to December 31, 2024
items.detail: The Ministry of Home Affairs extended the cut-off entry date under the Citizenship Amendment Act framework to December 31, 2024, from December 31, 2014.
examFacts: New CAA cut-off entry date: 31 December 2024 (earlier 31 December 2014)

items.headline: Cabinet approves Rs 1,500 crore critical mineral recycling scheme
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved a Rs 1,500 crore scheme to recycle critical minerals from sources such as e-waste and lithium-ion battery scrap, for FY 2025-26 to FY 2030-31.
examFacts: Critical mineral recycling scheme: Rs 1,500 crore

items.headline: GST Council approves two-slab structure of 5% and 18%
items.detail: The 56th GST Council, chaired by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, approved a two-tier GST structure of 5% and 18%, effective September 22, 2025, along with a special 40% rate for select items.

items.headline: SRS 2023: infant mortality rate falls to 25
items.detail: The Sample Registration System 2023 report showed India's infant mortality rate fell to 25 per 1,000 live births and the total fertility rate fell to 1.9.

items.headline: IIT Madras tops NIRF 2025 for seventh straight year
items.detail: IIT Madras topped the overall NIRF 2025 rankings for the seventh consecutive year, followed by IISc Bengaluru and IIT Bombay.
examFacts: NIRF 2025 overall: IIT Madras 1st (7th year in a row)

items.headline: Anutin Charnvirakul elected Thailand's 32nd Prime Minister
items.detail: Anutin Charnvirakul of the Bhumjaithai Party was elected Thailand's 32nd PM with 311 votes. He succeeded Paetongtarn Shinawatra, who was dismissed by the Constitutional Court.

items.headline: Anuparna Roy wins Best Director at Venice Orizzonti
items.detail: Indian filmmaker Anuparna Roy won Best Director in the Orizzonti section of the 82nd Venice Film Festival for her debut feature 'Songs of Forgotten Trees'.
examFacts: Anuparna Roy: Best Director, Orizzonti (82nd Venice Film Festival)

items.headline: India and Israel sign Bilateral Investment Treaty
items.detail: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman and Israel's Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich signed a Bilateral Investment Treaty in New Delhi. Israel became the first OECD member state to sign such an agreement with India.

items.headline: India's first bamboo-based bio-refinery at Numaligarh
items.detail: India's first bamboo-based bio-refinery at Numaligarh, Assam was inaugurated on September 14. It can produce 49,000 tonnes of bioethanol per year.

items.headline: Sushila Karki becomes Nepal's first woman Prime Minister
items.detail: Former Chief Justice Sushila Karki was sworn in as Nepal's interim Prime Minister, the first woman to hold the post. General elections were set for March 5, 2026.
examFacts: Nepal's first woman PM: Sushila Karki (interim)

items.headline: Samudra Pradakshina: first tri-service all-women circumnavigation
items.detail: Rajnath Singh flagged off Samudra Pradakshina from Mumbai, the world's first tri-service all-women circumnavigation, with 10 women officers aboard IASV Triveni.
examFacts: Crew: 10 women officers from Army, Navy and Air Force

items.headline: Rs 100 coin for Bhupen Hazarika centenary
items.detail: During his Assam visit on September 13-14, PM Modi released a Rs 100 commemorative coin for Dr. Bhupen Hazarika's 100th birth anniversary.

items.headline: Navy commissions INS Aravali in Gurugram
items.detail: The Indian Navy commissioned the naval base INS Aravali in Gurugram, Haryana. Its motto is 'Maritime Security through Collaboration'.

items.headline: India finishes 3rd at World Boxing Championships
items.detail: At the World Boxing Championships in Liverpool from September 4-14, India won 4 medals and finished third. Minakshi Hooda and Jaismine Lamboria won gold.
examFacts: India's gold medallists: Minakshi Hooda, Jaismine Lamboria

items.headline: Vaishali wins FIDE Women's Grand Swiss
items.detail: R. Vaishali won the FIDE Women's Grand Swiss in Samarkand with 8 points from 11. Anish Giri of the Netherlands won the Open section.
examFacts: FIDE Women's Grand Swiss 2025: R. Vaishali

items.headline: India ranks 38th in Global Innovation Index 2025
items.detail: India rose to 38th in the Global Innovation Index 2025, up from 39th. Switzerland ranked first, followed by Sweden and the USA.

items.headline: Mauritius PM Ramgoolam visits India
items.detail: Mauritius PM Ramgoolam visited India from September 9-16, 2025. India announced a special economic package worth USD 680 million for Mauritius.
examFacts: India's package for Mauritius: USD 680 million

items.headline: Central Zone wins Duleep Trophy
items.detail: Central Zone, captained by Rajat Patidar, beat South Zone by 6 wickets to win the Duleep Trophy, their 7th title.

items.headline: Mohanlal to receive Dadasaheb Phalke Award
items.detail: Malayalam actor Mohanlal was named for the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2023. He is the second Malayalam film personality to get it, after Adoor Gopalakrishnan.

items.headline: Zorawar light tank unveiled
items.detail: The Zorawar light tank, developed by DRDO and Larsen and Toubro, weighs 25 tonnes and carries a 105 mm gun. Induction is targeted for 2027.
examFacts: Zorawar light tank: DRDO and L&T, 25 tonnes

items.headline: OECD raises India's FY26 growth forecast to 6.7%
items.detail: The OECD raised India's FY26 GDP growth forecast to 6.7% from 6.3%, and projected 6.2% for FY27.

items.headline: UPI launched in Qatar
items.detail: UPI services were launched in Qatar with Qatar National Bank, making Qatar the 8th country to adopt UPI.

items.headline: Agni-Prime test-fired from rail-based launcher
items.detail: India test-fired the Agni-Prime missile from a Rail-Based Mobile Launcher, a first-of-its-kind launch from a specially designed rail platform.
examFacts: Agni-Prime: first launch from a rail-based mobile launcher

items.headline: Rs 62,370 crore deal for 97 Tejas Mk1A jets
items.detail: The Defence Ministry signed a Rs 62,370 crore contract with HAL for 97 Tejas Mk1A fighters, with deliveries from 2027-28. Total Tejas Mk1A orders rose to 180.

items.headline: Maldives becomes 181st IAEA member
items.detail: At the 69th IAEA General Conference in Vienna from September 15-19, the Maldives became the agency's 181st member state.

items.headline: BSNL launches Swadeshi 4G network
items.detail: BSNL's indigenous 4G network was launched at Jharsuguda, Odisha, with 97,500 towers commissioned at a cost of about Rs 37,000 crore.

items.headline: Cold Desert becomes India's 13th UNESCO biosphere reserve
items.detail: The Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve in Lahaul-Spiti, Himachal Pradesh, covering 7,770 sq km, was added to UNESCO's network. It is India's 13th biosphere reserve in the network.
examFacts: Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve: Lahaul-Spiti, Himachal Pradesh

items.headline: Ahmednagar railway station renamed Ahilyanagar
items.detail: Ahmednagar railway station in Maharashtra was renamed Ahilyanagar in honour of Ahilyabai Holkar.

items.headline: 'Homebound' is India's Oscar entry
items.detail: Neeraj Ghaywan's Hindi film 'Homebound' was chosen as India's entry for Best International Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.

items.headline: Sheetal Devi wins gold at World Para Archery Championships
items.detail: At the World Para Archery Championships in Gwangju, India finished second with 2 gold, 2 silver and 1 bronze. Sheetal Devi won gold, becoming the first armless woman world champion, and Toman Kumar won the men's compound gold.
examFacts: Sheetal Devi: first armless woman para archery world champion

items.headline: T.C.A. Kalyani becomes 29th Controller General of Accounts
items.detail: T.C.A. Kalyani, a 1991-batch ICAS officer, took charge as the 29th Controller General of Accounts in the Department of Expenditure on September 1, 2025. The post was earlier held by S.S. Dubey.
examFacts: CGA works under: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance

items.headline: India-Thailand Exercise Maitree held in Meghalaya
items.detail: The 14th edition of the India-Thailand joint military exercise Maitree was held at Umroi, Meghalaya from September 1-14, 2025, with a focus on counter-terrorism in semi-urban terrain.

items.headline: Yudh Abhyas 2025 held in Alaska
items.detail: The 21st edition of the India-USA army exercise Yudh Abhyas was held at Fort Wainwright, Alaska from September 1-14, 2025. The Indian contingent came from the Madras Regiment.
examFacts: Yudh Abhyas: India-USA army exercise (21st edition)

items.headline: National Nutrition Week observed
items.detail: National Nutrition Week was observed from September 1-7, 2025 on the theme 'Eat Right for a Better Life'. The week was started in 1982 by the Food and Nutrition Board.
examFacts: 2025 theme: 'Eat Right for a Better Life'

items.headline: HUID-based hallmarking introduced for silver jewellery
items.detail: The government introduced a six-digit HUID hallmarking system for silver jewellery from September 1, 2025, with seven purity grades under the revised IS 2112:2025 standard.

items.headline: World Coconut Day observed
items.detail: World Coconut Day was observed on September 2 on the theme 'Uncovering Coconut's Power, Inspiring Global Action'. The day was established by the Asian and Pacific Coconut Community.

items.headline: Singapore PM Lawrence Wong visits India
items.detail: Singapore PM Lawrence Wong visited India from September 2-4, 2025, marking 60 years of diplomatic relations. The two sides adopted a roadmap for their Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and signed 5 MoUs.

items.headline: SEMICON India 2025: Vikram-32 processor unveiled
items.detail: At SEMICON India 2025 at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi, PM Modi unveiled Vikram-32, described as India's first indigenous 32-bit microprocessor.

items.headline: Andrew Holness wins third straight term in Jamaica
items.detail: Andrew Holness's Jamaica Labour Party won the September 3 general election with 34 seats. He became the first JLP leader to serve three consecutive terms as PM.
examFacts: Jamaica PM: Andrew Holness (third consecutive term)

items.headline: Amit Mishra retires from international cricket
items.detail: Leg-spinner Amit Mishra retired from international cricket on September 4, 2025. He took 76 wickets in 22 Tests and 174 wickets in 162 IPL matches, including 3 hat-tricks.

items.headline: Teachers' Day: 81 teachers get National Teachers' Awards
items.detail: Teachers' Day was observed on September 5, the birth anniversary of Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan. President Droupadi Murmu presented National Teachers' Awards to 81 teachers.
examFacts: Teachers' Day: 5 September (Dr. S. Radhakrishnan's birth anniversary)
International Day of Charity: also 5 September

items.headline: India wins Men's Hockey Asia Cup at Rajgir
items.detail: India beat South Korea 4-1 in the final of the Men's Hockey Asia Cup at Rajgir, Bihar on September 7, 2025. This was India's fourth Asia Cup title, and it earned a place at the 2026 FIH World Cup.

items.headline: Alcaraz and Sabalenka win US Open 2025
items.detail: Carlos Alcaraz won the men's singles title and Aryna Sabalenka won the women's singles title at the US Open 2025.
examFacts: US Open 2025: Carlos Alcaraz (men), Aryna Sabalenka (women)

items.headline: International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies
items.detail: The 6th International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies was observed on September 7 on the theme 'Racing for Air. Every Breath Matters'.
examFacts: Clean Air for Blue Skies Day: 7 September

items.headline: International Literacy Day: Himachal fully literate
items.detail: International Literacy Day was observed on September 8 on the theme 'Promoting Literacy in the Digital Era'. Himachal Pradesh became the fourth state to achieve full functional literacy.
examFacts: Himachal Pradesh: 4th fully functionally literate state

items.headline: Injeti Srinivas named NSE Chairperson
items.detail: Former IAS officer Injeti Srinivas, the founding Chairperson of IFSCA, was appointed Chairperson of the National Stock Exchange, succeeding Girish Chandra Chaturvedi.

items.headline: Sebastien Lecornu appointed French Prime Minister
items.detail: Former Defence Minister Sebastien Lecornu was appointed Prime Minister of France on September 9, 2025, succeeding Francois Bayrou.
examFacts: French PM: Sebastien Lecornu (succeeded Francois Bayrou)

items.headline: Indore tops Swachh Vayu Survekshan 2025
items.detail: Indore topped Category 1 of the Swachh Vayu Survekshan 2025 with a score of 200. The survey covered 130 cities under the National Clean Air Programme.

items.headline: India joins Exercise Zapad 2025 in Russia
items.detail: India sent 65 personnel to the Russia-Belarus joint military exercise Zapad 2025, held from September 10-16.
examFacts: Zapad: Russia-Belarus exercise; India took part with 65 personnel

items.headline: C.P. Radhakrishnan sworn in as 15th Vice President
items.detail: Former Maharashtra Governor C.P. Radhakrishnan was sworn in as India's 15th Vice President on September 12, 2025. He won 452 votes against the opposition candidate's 300. Gujarat Governor Acharya Devvrat was given additional charge of Maharashtra.

items.headline: PM inaugurates Bairabi-Sairang rail line in Mizoram
items.detail: On September 13, PM Modi inaugurated the 51.38 km Bairabi-Sairang rail line in Mizoram, built at Rs 8,070 crore with 45 tunnels.

items.headline: WTO Fisheries Subsidies Agreement comes into force
items.detail: The WTO Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies, adopted in June 2022, came into force on September 15, 2025 after enough members ratified it.
examFacts: WTO Fisheries Subsidies Agreement in force: 15 September 2025

items.headline: Combined Commanders' Conference held in Kolkata
items.detail: The 16th Combined Commanders' Conference was held at Vijay Durg, Kolkata from September 15-17, 2025, on the theme 'Year of Reforms - Transformation for the Future'.

items.headline: World Ozone Day observed
items.detail: The International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer was observed on September 16 on the theme 'From Science to Global Action'.

items.headline: Actor-director Robert Redford dies at 89
items.detail: Hollywood actor and director Robert Redford died on September 16, 2025, aged 89. He won the Oscar for Best Director for 'Ordinary People' (1980).
examFacts: Robert Redford: Best Director Oscar for 'Ordinary People'

items.headline: PM MITRA Park in Dhar and women's health campaign launched
items.detail: On September 17 in Madhya Pradesh, PM Modi inaugurated the PM MITRA Park at Dhar and launched the Swasth Nari, Sashakt Parivar Abhiyaan, which ran until October 2.
examFacts: PM MITRA Park: Dhar, Madhya Pradesh
Swasth Nari, Sashakt Parivar Abhiyaan: 17 September-2 October

items.headline: National Geothermal Energy Policy 2025 notified
items.detail: The MNRE notified the National Geothermal Energy Policy 2025. It allows leases of up to 30 years for project developers.

items.headline: Swachhata Hi Seva 2025 campaign
items.detail: The 9th edition of the Swachhata Hi Seva campaign ran from September 17 to October 2, 2025.
examFacts: Swachhata Hi Seva 2025: 17 September-2 October (9th edition)

items.headline: High Seas Treaty crosses 60 ratifications
items.detail: The BBNJ (High Seas) Treaty crossed the 60-ratification threshold on September 19, 2025 and will enter into force on January 17, 2026.
examFacts: BBNJ Treaty entry into force: 17 January 2026

items.headline: Dembele and Bonmati win Ballon d'Or 2025
items.detail: Ousmane Dembele of PSG won the men's Ballon d'Or and Aitana Bonmati of Barcelona won the women's award for the third year in a row, at a ceremony in Paris on September 22.
examFacts: Ballon d'Or 2025: Ousmane Dembele (men), Aitana Bonmati (women)

items.headline: Rajnath Singh visits Morocco; Tata defence plant opens
items.detail: Rajnath Singh visited Morocco on September 22-23, 2025, the first visit by an Indian Defence Minister to the country. Tata Advanced Systems' defence plant at Berrechid was inaugurated.

items.headline: Ayushman Bharat completes seven years
items.detail: Ayushman Bharat completed seven years on September 23, 2025. It was launched on September 23, 2018 at Ranchi, Jharkhand.

items.headline: National Service Scheme Day
items.detail: NSS Day was observed on September 24. The National Service Scheme was launched on September 24, 1969 and its motto is 'Not Me But You'.

items.headline: Cabinet approves Rs 69,725 crore shipbuilding package
items.detail: The Cabinet approved a Rs 69,725 crore package to revive shipbuilding and maritime sectors, including a Maritime Development Fund of Rs 25,000 crore.

items.headline: Cabinet adds 10,000 medical seats
items.detail: The Cabinet approved 5,000 new PG seats and 5,023 new UG medical seats, with an outlay of Rs 15,034.50 crore for 2025-26 to 2028-29.
examFacts: New medical seats: 5,000 PG and 5,023 UG

items.headline: PM launches Rs 1.22 lakh crore projects in Rajasthan
items.detail: In Rajasthan on September 25, PM Modi launched projects worth over Rs 1.22 lakh crore, including the Rs 42,000 crore, 2,800 MW Mahi Banswara Atomic Power Project.
examFacts: Mahi Banswara Atomic Power Project: 2,800 MW, Rajasthan

items.headline: World Food India 2025 held at Bharat Mandapam
items.detail: The 4th edition of World Food India was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi from September 25-28 on the theme 'Processing for Prosperity'. New Zealand and Saudi Arabia were partner countries.

items.headline: IAF retires MiG-21 after 62 years
items.detail: The Indian Air Force retired the MiG-21 at Chandigarh Air Force Station on September 26, 2025. The jet joined the IAF in 1963, and over 870 were inducted.

items.headline: R. Venkataramani's term as Attorney General extended
items.detail: R. Venkataramani, the 16th Attorney General of India, was given a new term from October 1, 2025 to September 30, 2027.
examFacts: Attorney General: R. Venkataramani (term to 30 September 2027)

items.headline: Bihar Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana launched
items.detail: PM Modi launched Bihar's Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana on September 26, transferring Rs 10,000 each to 75 lakh women, a total of Rs 7,500 crore.
examFacts: Mahila Rojgar Yojana: Rs 10,000 each to 75 lakh women

items.headline: World Tourism Day observed
items.detail: World Tourism Day was observed on September 27 on the theme 'Tourism and Sustainable Transformation', with Melaka, Malaysia as the official host.

items.headline: India wins SAFF U-17 Championship
items.detail: India beat Bangladesh 4-1 on penalties to win the SAFF U-17 Championship in Colombo on September 27, 2025.

items.headline: India beats Pakistan to win Asia Cup 2025
items.detail: India beat Pakistan in the Asia Cup final at Dubai International Stadium on September 28, 2025, winning the title for the ninth time.

items.headline: World Rabies Day observed
items.detail: World Rabies Day was observed on September 28 on the theme 'Act Now: You, Me, Communities'.

items.headline: World Heart Day observed
items.detail: World Heart Day was observed on September 29 on the theme 'Don't Miss A Beat'.

items.headline: International Translation Day observed
items.detail: International Translation Day was observed on September 30 on the theme 'Celebrating Translation, Peace and Trust'.

quiz.q: Who was sworn in as India's 15th Vice President in September 2025?
quiz.solution: Former Maharashtra Governor C.P. Radhakrishnan won 452 votes and was sworn in on September 12, 2025.

quiz.q: Who became Nepal's first woman Prime Minister in September 2025?
quiz.solution: Former Chief Justice Sushila Karki became interim PM.

quiz.q: Under GST 2.0, effective September 22, 2025, what are the two main GST slabs?
quiz.solution: The 56th GST Council approved slabs of 5% and 18%, plus a special 40% rate.

quiz.q: The MiG-21 was retired by the IAF in September 2025. In which year was it inducted?
quiz.solution: The MiG-21 served the IAF for over 62 years, from 1963 to 2025.

quiz.q: Where was the Men's Hockey Asia Cup 2025 final, won by India, held?
quiz.solution: India beat South Korea 4-1 at Rajgir, Bihar for its fourth Asia Cup title.

quiz.q: Which institution topped the overall NIRF 2025 rankings?
quiz.solution: IIT Madras topped the overall list for the seventh consecutive year.

quiz.q: The Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve, added to UNESCO's network in 2025, is in which state?
quiz.solution: It is in Lahaul-Spiti, Himachal Pradesh, and is India's 13th biosphere reserve in the network.

quiz.q: What was India's rank in the Global Innovation Index 2025?
quiz.solution: India rose to 38th from 39th; Switzerland ranked first.

quiz.q: Which country became the 8th to adopt UPI in September 2025?
quiz.solution: UPI was launched in Qatar in partnership with Qatar National Bank.

quiz.q: Who won the FIDE Women's Grand Swiss 2025 in Samarkand?
quiz.solution: R. Vaishali won with 8 points from 11.

items.headline: Mukesh Ambani tops Hurun India Rich List 2025
items.detail: Mukesh Ambani topped the 14th Hurun India Rich List with Rs 9.55 lakh crore, followed by Gautam Adani and family. Roshni Nadar was the richest woman, and Perplexity's Aravind Srinivas, 31, was the youngest billionaire.
examFacts: Hurun India Rich List 2025: Mukesh Ambani 1st

items.headline: Balod becomes India's first child marriage-free district
items.detail: Balod district in Chhattisgarh was declared India's first child marriage-free district after verification of 436 gram panchayats and 9 urban bodies, with technical support from UNICEF.
examFacts: India's first child marriage-free district: Balod (Chhattisgarh)

items.headline: India re-elected to ICAO Council
items.detail: India was re-elected to the ICAO Council under Part II at the 42nd ICAO Assembly in Montreal, held from September 23 to October 3, 2025.
examFacts: India re-elected to ICAO Council (Part II)

items.headline: India wins ISSA Award for social security
items.detail: India received the ISSA Award 2025 for Outstanding Achievement in Social Security at the World Social Security Forum in Kuala Lumpur. Union Labour Minister Mansukh Mandaviya accepted the award.
examFacts: World Social Security Forum 2025: Kuala Lumpur

items.headline: BRO builds world's highest motorable road at Mig La
items.detail: The Border Roads Organisation built a road at 19,400 ft at Mig La pass in Ladakh, making it the world's highest motorable road and beating its own Umling La record of 19,024 ft.
examFacts: World's highest motorable road: Mig La, Ladakh (19,400 ft)

items.headline: Nobel Prize in Medicine for immune tolerance research
items.detail: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine went to Shimon Sakaguchi, Mary E. Brunkow and Fred Ramsdell for discoveries on immune tolerance.

items.headline: Nobel Prize in Physics for macroscopic quantum tunnelling
items.detail: John Clarke, Michel Devoret and John Martinis won the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics for discovering macroscopic quantum tunnelling in an electric circuit.

items.headline: Nobel Prize in Chemistry for metal-organic frameworks
items.detail: Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar M. Yaghi won the 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing metal-organic frameworks (MOFs).

items.headline: Laszlo Krasznahorkai wins Nobel Prize in Literature
items.detail: Hungarian author Laszlo Krasznahorkai won the 2025 Nobel Prize in Literature. He is the second Hungarian literature laureate after Imre Kertesz (2002).

items.headline: Maria Corina Machado wins Nobel Peace Prize 2025
items.detail: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado was awarded the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize for promoting democratic rights in Venezuela.
examFacts: Nobel Peace Prize 2025: Maria Corina Machado (Venezuela)

items.headline: Mokyr, Aghion and Howitt win Economics Nobel
items.detail: Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt won the 2025 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for explaining innovation-driven economic growth.

items.headline: India hosts World Para Athletics Championships
items.detail: India hosted the 12th World Para Athletics Championships in New Delhi and won 22 medals, including 6 gold, finishing 10th overall.
examFacts: World Para Athletics Championships 2025: New Delhi (12th edition)

items.headline: India tops ISSF Junior World Cup in New Delhi
items.detail: India topped the ISSF Junior World Cup in New Delhi with 26 medals, including 8 gold.
examFacts: ISSF Junior World Cup 2025: India topped (26 medals)

items.headline: PM launches Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana and pulses mission
items.detail: PM Modi launched the PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana and the Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses, with a combined outlay of Rs 35,440 crore. PMDDKY covers 100 agri-districts from 2025-26 to 2030-31.

items.headline: Rajnath Singh holds first India-Australia Defence Ministers' Dialogue
items.detail: Rajnath Singh made the first visit to Australia by an Indian Defence Minister since 2014 and co-chaired the inaugural India-Australia Defence Ministers' Dialogue, where three defence agreements were signed.
examFacts: Inaugural India-Australia Defence Ministers' Dialogue: October 2025

items.headline: Five Maharashtra beaches get Blue Flag tag
items.detail: Five Maharashtra beaches, Shrivardhan, Nagaon, Parnaka, Guhagar and Ladghar, received Blue Flag certification, taking India's total to 18.

items.headline: Dan Katz named IMF First Deputy Managing Director
items.detail: American economist Dan Katz was appointed First Deputy Managing Director of the IMF, succeeding Gita Gopinath.
examFacts: IMF First Deputy MD: Dan Katz (succeeds Gita Gopinath)

items.headline: Maldives first to achieve WHO triple elimination
items.detail: The Maldives became the first country to receive WHO validation for eliminating mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B.
examFacts: First country with WHO triple elimination: Maldives

items.headline: Retail inflation falls to 99-month low of 1.54%
items.detail: CPI inflation fell to 1.54% in September 2025, a 99-month low, while food inflation fell to -2.28%.

items.headline: India elected to UN Human Rights Council for 7th time
items.detail: India was elected to the UN Human Rights Council for the 2026-28 term with 177 votes, its seventh term on the council.

items.headline: IMF raises India's FY26 growth forecast to 6.6%
items.detail: The IMF raised India's FY26 GDP growth forecast to 6.6% and projected 6.2% for FY27.

items.headline: Tarun Garg to be first Indian MD and CEO of Hyundai India
items.detail: Tarun Garg will become MD and CEO of Hyundai Motor India from January 1, 2026, the first Indian to lead the company since it began in 1996.
examFacts: Hyundai Motor India MD and CEO: Tarun Garg (from 1 January 2026)

items.headline: Mirabai Chanu wins silver at World Weightlifting Championships
items.detail: Mirabai Chanu won silver in the women's 48 kg category at the World Weightlifting Championships with a 199 kg total.
examFacts: Mirabai Chanu: silver, 48 kg (199 kg total)

items.headline: India ranks 85th in Henley Passport Index
items.detail: India fell to 85th in the October Henley Passport Index with visa-free access to 57 destinations. Singapore topped the list.

items.headline: Mongolia's President visits India; joins ISA
items.detail: Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khurelsukh visited India from October 13-16, 2025, marking 70 years of diplomatic ties. Mongolia joined the International Solar Alliance.

items.headline: Madhya Pradesh, Goa and Punjab top State Mining Readiness Index
items.detail: The Ministry of Mines released the first State Mining Readiness Index. Madhya Pradesh, Goa and Punjab topped their respective categories.
examFacts: State Mining Readiness Index toppers: MP, Goa, Punjab

items.headline: India ranks 52nd in Global Pension Index 2025
items.detail: In the Mercer CFA Global Pension Index 2025, the Netherlands ranked first and India was 52nd.

items.headline: Emirates NBD to buy 60% of RBL Bank
items.detail: Emirates NBD agreed to acquire a 60% stake in RBL Bank for Rs 26,850 crore, the largest FDI in India's financial sector.
examFacts: Emirates NBD-RBL Bank deal: 60% for Rs 26,850 crore

items.headline: Shantha Rangaswamy first woman president of ICA
items.detail: Former India captain Shantha Rangaswamy became the first woman president of the Indian Cricketers' Association.
examFacts: First woman ICA president: Shantha Rangaswamy

items.headline: Nobel physicist Chen-Ning Yang dies at 103
items.detail: Physicist Chen-Ning Yang died in Beijing at 103. He shared the 1957 Nobel Prize in Physics with Tsung-Dao Lee for the discovery of parity violation.

items.headline: Sanae Takaichi becomes Japan's first woman Prime Minister
items.detail: Sanae Takaichi was elected by both houses of the Diet as Japan's first woman Prime Minister.
examFacts: Japan's first woman PM: Sanae Takaichi

items.headline: Justice Prathiba Singh to chair WIPO Advisory Board of Judges
items.detail: Justice Prathiba M. Singh became the first Indian Chair of the WIPO Advisory Board of Judges for 2025-2027.
examFacts: First Indian Chair of WIPO Advisory Board of Judges: Justice Prathiba M. Singh

items.headline: Nafithromycin: India's first indigenously discovered antibiotic
items.detail: India developed Nafithromycin, its first indigenously discovered antibiotic, for drug-resistant respiratory infections.

items.headline: Chennai gets India's first real-time flood forecasting system
items.detail: Chennai became India's first city with a real-time flood forecasting system, covering 4,974 sq km across the Adyar, Cooum, Kosasthalaiyar and Kovalam basins.
examFacts: First real-time flood forecasting city: Chennai

items.headline: India ranks 9th in forest area in Global Forest Resources Assessment
items.detail: The Global Forest Resources Assessment 2025 ranked India 9th in forest area with 72.74 million hectares, about 2% of the world's forests. Russia led the list.
examFacts: India's forest area rank: 9th (72.74 million ha)

items.headline: Sunil Amrith wins British Academy Book Prize
items.detail: Indian-origin historian Sunil Amrith won the British Academy Book Prize for 'The Burning Earth: An Environmental History of the Last 500 Years'.
examFacts: British Academy Book Prize 2025: Sunil Amrith, 'The Burning Earth'

items.headline: Morocco wins FIFA U-20 World Cup
items.detail: Morocco beat Argentina 2-0 in Santiago, Chile, to win the FIFA U-20 World Cup, the first Arab nation to win the title.
examFacts: FIFA U-20 World Cup 2025: Morocco (beat Argentina)

items.headline: Space pioneer Eknath Vasant Chitnis dies at 100
items.detail: Space scientist Dr. Eknath Vasant Chitnis, who was instrumental in selecting Thumba, Kerala for India's first rocket launch, died at 100. He received the Padma Bhushan in 1985.
examFacts: E.V. Chitnis: helped select Thumba for India's first rocket launch

items.headline: Defence Procurement Manual 2025 released
items.detail: Rajnath Singh released the Defence Procurement Manual 2025, effective November 1, 2025, replacing DPM 2009. The Defence Acquisition Council also cleared proposals worth about Rs 79,000 crore.

items.headline: Vivek Menon first Asian to chair IUCN Species Survival Commission
items.detail: Indian conservationist Vivek Menon was elected Chair of the IUCN Species Survival Commission for 2025-2029, the first Asian in the post.
examFacts: IUCN SSC Chair 2025-29: Vivek Menon (first Asian)

items.headline: Jayant Narlikar gets Vigyan Ratna posthumously
items.detail: Prof. Jayant Vishnu Narlikar was given the Vigyan Ratna posthumously in the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar 2025.

items.headline: Cabinet approves ToR of 8th Central Pay Commission
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved the terms of reference of the 8th Central Pay Commission, with Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai as chairperson. It is to report within 18 months.
examFacts: 8th CPC chairperson: Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai

items.headline: Patrick Herminie sworn in as Seychelles President
items.detail: Dr. Patrick Herminie was sworn in as the 6th President of Seychelles in October 2025. Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan represented India.

items.headline: 8th ISA Assembly held in New Delhi
items.detail: The 8th Assembly of the International Solar Alliance was held from October 27-30 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, chaired by Pralhad Joshi. The SUNRISE initiative was launched there.

items.headline: India tops South Asian Athletics Championships in Ranchi
items.detail: India hosted the 4th South Asian Athletics Federation Senior Championships in Ranchi from October 24-26 and topped the table with 20 gold medals.
examFacts: SAAF Championships 2025: Ranchi, India topped (20 gold)

items.headline: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.5%
items.detail: In its fourth bi-monthly policy of FY26, the RBI Monetary Policy Committee chaired by Governor Sanjay Malhotra kept the repo rate at 5.5% with a neutral stance. SDF stayed at 5.25% and MSF/Bank Rate at 5.75%.

items.headline: PM releases Rs 100 coin for RSS centenary
items.detail: PM Modi addressed the RSS centenary event in New Delhi and released a Rs 100 commemorative silver coin and a postage stamp. The RSS was founded on September 27, 1925 in Nagpur by Dr. K.B. Hedgewar.

items.headline: UPSC enters its centenary year
items.detail: The Union Public Service Commission entered its 100th year on October 1, 2025 and unveiled a new logo. UPSC was established in 1926; its Chairman is Dr. Ajay Kumar.

items.headline: Cabinet raises rabi MSP and approves pulses mission
items.detail: The Union Cabinet raised MSP for six rabi crops, with wheat at Rs 2,585 per quintal and the highest increase for safflower. It also approved the Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses with Rs 11,440 crore to raise output from 24.2 MT to 35 MT by 2030-31.

items.headline: India-EFTA trade pact TEPA comes into force
items.detail: The India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement came into force on October 1, 2025. EFTA countries pledged USD 100 billion of investment and 1 million direct jobs in India over 15 years.
examFacts: Investment pledge: USD 100 billion over 15 years

items.headline: Lt Gen Virendra Vats becomes 35th DG of NCC
items.detail: Lt Gen Virendra Vats took charge as the 35th Director General of the National Cadet Corps on October 1, 2025, succeeding Lt Gen Gurbirpal Singh.
examFacts: 35th DG NCC: Lt Gen Virendra Vats

items.headline: Classical vocalist Pandit Chhannulal Mishra dies at 89
items.detail: Hindustani classical vocalist Pandit Chhannulal Mishra, known as the 'Voice of Banaras', died on October 2, 2025. He received the Padma Bhushan in 2010 and the Padma Vibhushan in 2020.

items.headline: India-UK carrier exercise KONKAN-2025
items.detail: The Indian Navy and Royal Navy held KONKAN-2025 from October 5-12, with carrier strike groups led by INS Vikrant and HMS Prince of Wales.
examFacts: Carriers: INS Vikrant and HMS Prince of Wales

items.headline: PM inaugurates Navi Mumbai International Airport
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated the Rs 19,650 crore Navi Mumbai International Airport, built by Adani Airports and CIDCO under a PPP model. The airport is named after Loknete D.B. Patil.
examFacts: Navi Mumbai airport named after: Loknete D.B. Patil

items.headline: UK PM Keir Starmer visits India
items.detail: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer visited India on October 8-9, 2025. The two sides launched an India-UK Fintech Corridor, and nine UK universities announced campuses in India.
examFacts: Nine UK university campuses announced in India

items.headline: India Mobile Congress 2025 held at Yashobhoomi
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated the 9th India Mobile Congress, held from October 8-11 at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi, on the theme 'Innovate to Transform'.

items.headline: Shirish Chandra Murmu takes charge as RBI Deputy Governor
items.detail: Shirish Chandra Murmu took charge as RBI Deputy Governor on October 9, 2025 for a three-year term, succeeding Rajeshwar Rao. His portfolio includes communication, regulation and enforcement.
examFacts: New RBI Deputy Governor: Shirish Chandra Murmu

items.headline: World Mental Health Day observed
items.detail: World Mental Health Day was observed on October 10 on the theme of access to mental health services in catastrophes and emergencies. Actor Deepika Padukone was named Mental Health Ambassador.

items.headline: Three ports named Green Hydrogen Hubs
items.detail: The MNRE recognised Deendayal Port (Gujarat), V.O. Chidambaranar Port (Tamil Nadu) and Paradip Port (Odisha) as Green Hydrogen Hubs under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
examFacts: Green Hydrogen Hub ports: Deendayal, V.O. Chidambaranar, Paradip

items.headline: India-Australia Exercise AUSTRAHIND 2025 in Perth
items.detail: The 4th edition of the India-Australia army exercise AUSTRAHIND was held in Perth from October 13-26, 2025.
examFacts: AUSTRAHIND: India-Australia army exercise (4th edition, Perth)

items.headline: India-Indonesia Exercise Samudra Shakti in Visakhapatnam
items.detail: The 5th edition of the India-Indonesia naval exercise Samudra Shakti was held at Visakhapatnam from October 14-17, 2025.
examFacts: Samudra Shakti: India-Indonesia naval exercise (5th edition)

items.headline: Indian Army hosts UN Troop Contributing Countries Chiefs Conclave
items.detail: The Indian Army hosted the UNTCC Chiefs Conclave in New Delhi from October 14-16, 2025, with 32 nations taking part.
examFacts: UNTCC Chiefs Conclave 2025: New Delhi, 32 nations

items.headline: Former Kenyan PM Raila Odinga dies in Kerala
items.detail: Former Kenyan Prime Minister Raila Odinga died in Kerala on October 15, 2025, aged 80. He was Prime Minister from 2008 to 2013.

items.headline: First Tejas Mk1A from Nashik line unveiled
items.detail: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh unveiled the first LCA Tejas Mk1A built at HAL's third production line in Nashik on October 17, 2025.
examFacts: Tejas Mk1A third production line: Nashik

items.headline: Police Commemoration Day observed
items.detail: Police Commemoration Day was observed on October 21 to honour police personnel killed on duty. It marks the 1959 Hot Springs incident in Ladakh, where 10 policemen were killed by Chinese troops.

items.headline: Ad legend Piyush Pandey dies at 70
items.detail: Advertising veteran and Padma Shri awardee Piyush Pandey died on October 24, 2025, aged 70.

items.headline: Timor-Leste joins ASEAN as 11th member
items.detail: At the 47th ASEAN Summit in Kuala Lumpur on October 26-28, Timor-Leste became ASEAN's 11th member. At the ASEAN-India Summit, PM Modi declared 2026 the ASEAN-India Year of Maritime Cooperation.

items.headline: Tri-services Exercise Trishul on western border
items.detail: The Army, Navy and Air Force began Exercise Trishul along the western border on October 30, running until November 10, 2025.

items.headline: National Unity Day marks Sardar Patel's 150th birth anniversary
items.detail: National Unity Day was observed on October 31, the 150th birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, and a Rs 150 commemorative coin was released.
examFacts: National Unity Day: 31 October (Sardar Patel's birthday)

items.headline: Lucknow named UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy
items.detail: Lucknow was named a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy at the 43rd UNESCO General Conference in Samarkand. It is India's second city in this category after Hyderabad.
examFacts: Lucknow: UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy

quiz.q: Who won the Nobel Peace Prize 2025?
quiz.solution: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado won for promoting democratic rights.

quiz.q: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Literature went to an author from which country?
quiz.solution: Laszlo Krasznahorkai of Hungary won; Imre Kertesz (2002) was the first Hungarian winner.

quiz.q: The world's highest motorable road, built by BRO at 19,400 ft, is at which pass?
quiz.solution: Mig La in Ladakh beat BRO's earlier Umling La record of 19,024 ft.

quiz.q: Which country became the 11th member of ASEAN in October 2025?
quiz.solution: Timor-Leste joined ASEAN at the 47th Summit in Kuala Lumpur.

quiz.q: Who became Japan's first woman Prime Minister in October 2025?
quiz.solution: Sanae Takaichi was elected by both houses of the Diet.

quiz.q: Who is the chairperson of the 8th Central Pay Commission?
quiz.solution: The Cabinet approved the ToR with Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai as chairperson.

quiz.q: Which Indian city was named a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy on October 31, 2025?
quiz.solution: Lucknow is India's second gastronomy city after Hyderabad.

quiz.q: Which country became the first to receive WHO validation for triple elimination of mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B?
quiz.solution: The Maldives was the first country to achieve this validation.

quiz.q: KONKAN-2025, featuring INS Vikrant and HMS Prince of Wales, was an exercise between India and which country?
quiz.solution: KONKAN is the India-UK naval exercise.

quiz.q: Which district became India's first child marriage-free district?
quiz.solution: Balod district in Chhattisgarh was certified child marriage-free.

items.headline: India's installed power capacity crosses 500 GW
items.detail: India's installed power capacity reached 500.89 GW as of September 30, 2025. Non-fossil sources made up 256.09 GW, or 51%, meeting the Panchamrit goal five years early.
examFacts: Non-fossil share: 51% (target met five years early)

items.headline: LVM3-M5 launches Navy's heaviest communication satellite CMS-03
items.detail: ISRO's LVM3-M5 rocket launched CMS-03 (GSAT-7R), a 4,410 kg satellite. It is India's heaviest military communication satellite, built for the Indian Navy to replace GSAT-7 (Rukmini).

items.headline: Rohan Bopanna retires from professional tennis
items.detail: Rohan Bopanna announced his retirement from professional tennis. He won the 2017 French Open mixed doubles and the 2024 Australian Open men's doubles, and is the oldest men's doubles world No. 1.
examFacts: Rohan Bopanna: oldest world No. 1 in men's doubles
Grand Slams: 2017 French Open mixed, 2024 Australian Open men's doubles

items.headline: India releases AI Governance Guidelines
items.detail: India released its AI Governance Guidelines, drafted by a panel chaired by Prof. Balaraman Ravindran.
examFacts: AI Governance Guidelines panel chair: Prof. Balaraman Ravindran

items.headline: UNEP Emissions Gap Report 2025 released
items.detail: UNEP's Emissions Gap Report 2025 said global greenhouse gas emissions reached 57.7 GtCO2e in 2024, up 2.3%. India recorded the largest absolute rise, and warming is projected at 2.3-2.5 degrees C.

items.headline: IIT Delhi best Indian institute in QS Asia Rankings 2026
items.detail: The University of Hong Kong topped the QS Asia University Rankings 2026. IIT Delhi was India's best at 59th, and India had 294 ranked institutions.
examFacts: QS Asia Rankings 2026 topper: University of Hong Kong

items.headline: Amul ranked world's top cooperative
items.detail: The World Cooperative Monitor 2025 ranked Amul as the world's No. 1 cooperative, with IFFCO second.

items.headline: SBI crosses USD 100 billion market capitalisation
items.detail: State Bank of India crossed USD 100 billion in market capitalisation, becoming the sixth Indian company to do so.
examFacts: SBI: 6th Indian company to cross USD 100 billion market cap

items.headline: Shiv Nadar tops Hurun India Philanthropy List 2025
items.detail: Shiv Nadar topped the Hurun India Philanthropy List 2025 with donations of Rs 2,708 crore.
examFacts: Hurun India Philanthropy List 2025 topper: Shiv Nadar (Rs 2,708 crore)

items.headline: Four new Vande Bharat trains flagged off from Varanasi
items.detail: PM Modi flagged off four Vande Bharat trains from Varanasi, including Banaras-Khajuraho, Lucknow-Saharanpur, Firozpur-Delhi and Ernakulam-Bengaluru, taking the total to 164.

items.headline: Rs 1,000 crore IN-SPACe-SIDBI Space Venture Fund launched
items.detail: IN-SPACe and SIDBI launched a Rs 1,000 crore Space Venture Fund to support spacetech startups.
examFacts: IN-SPACe-SIDBI Space Venture Fund: Rs 1,000 crore

items.headline: Cabinet fixes royalty for four critical minerals
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved royalty rates for four critical minerals: graphite, caesium, rubidium and zirconium.
examFacts: Critical minerals with new royalty: graphite, caesium, rubidium, zirconium

items.headline: Khaled El-Enany becomes 12th UNESCO Director-General
items.detail: Egypt's Khaled El-Enany became the 12th Director-General of UNESCO. He is the first Arab to lead the organisation.

items.headline: WHO TB report: India's TB incidence down 21%
items.detail: WHO's Global TB Report 2025 said India's TB incidence fell 21% between 2015 and 2024. India still accounts for about 25% of global TB cases.
examFacts: India's share of global TB cases: about 25%

items.headline: Unemployment rate at 5.2% in July-September quarter
items.detail: The Periodic Labour Force Survey showed India's unemployment rate at 5.2% in the July-September 2025 quarter.

items.headline: India's largest green hydrogen plant commissioned in Karnataka
items.detail: JSW commissioned India's largest green hydrogen plant at Vijayanagar, Karnataka, to supply its steel plant.
examFacts: India's largest green hydrogen plant: Vijayanagar, Karnataka (JSW)

items.headline: 'Tree Woman' Saalumarada Thimmakka dies at 114
items.detail: Environmentalist Saalumarada Thimmakka of Karnataka, known as the 'Tree Woman', died at 114. She received the Padma Shri in 2019.

items.headline: 16th Finance Commission submits report to the President
items.detail: The 16th Finance Commission, chaired by Arvind Panagariya, submitted its report for 2026-31 to President Murmu.

items.headline: WPI inflation falls to 27-month low of -1.21%
items.detail: Wholesale price inflation fell to -1.21% in October 2025, a 27-month low, while CPI inflation was 0.25%.

items.headline: Nitish Kumar sworn in as Bihar CM for record 10th time
items.detail: Nitish Kumar took oath as Bihar Chief Minister for a record 10th time after the NDA won 202 of 243 seats. Samrat Choudhary and Vijay Kumar Sinha became Deputy CMs.

items.headline: Michelle Bachelet gets Indira Gandhi Peace Prize 2024
items.detail: Former Chile President Michelle Bachelet was chosen for the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development for 2024.
examFacts: Indira Gandhi Peace Prize 2024: Michelle Bachelet

items.headline: BIRSA 101: India's first indigenous CRISPR gene therapy
items.detail: India launched BIRSA 101, its first indigenous CRISPR-based gene therapy for sickle cell disease, developed by CSIR-IGIB.
examFacts: BIRSA 101: CRISPR gene therapy for sickle cell disease

items.headline: India slips to 23rd in Climate Change Performance Index 2026
items.detail: The Climate Change Performance Index 2026 ranked India 23rd, down 13 places.

items.headline: India wins 20 medals at World Boxing Cup Finals
items.detail: India won 20 medals, including nine gold, at the World Boxing Cup Finals in Greater Noida. Nikhat Zareen, Jaismine and Minakshi were among the gold medallists.
examFacts: World Boxing Cup Finals 2025: Greater Noida, India won 20 medals (9 gold)

items.headline: India's best-ever Deaflympics finish in Tokyo
items.detail: India finished sixth, its best ever, at the 25th Deaflympics in Tokyo with 20 medals, including nine gold. Ukraine topped the table.

items.headline: Italy wins third straight Davis Cup title
items.detail: Italy beat Spain in the final to win the Davis Cup for the third year in a row.

items.headline: Kerala declared first state free of extreme poverty
items.detail: Kerala was declared India's first state to eradicate extreme poverty on November 1, 2025. The Extreme Poverty Eradication Programme covered 64,006 families.
examFacts: First state to eradicate extreme poverty: Kerala

items.headline: Chhattisgarh marks 25th Foundation Day; new Assembly building opened
items.detail: On Chhattisgarh's 25th Foundation Day, a new Vidhan Sabha building and projects worth Rs 14,260 crore were inaugurated. India's first digital tribal museum, named after Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh, opened in Nava Raipur.
examFacts: India's first digital tribal museum: Nava Raipur (Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh)

items.headline: India wins first Women's ODI World Cup
